title: GLUScope: A Tool for Analyzing GLU Neurons in Transformer Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.23826v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present **GLUScope**, an open-source resource for analyzing neurons in Transformer-based language models (LMs), intended for interpretability researchers. We focus on the now-standard *GLU-based activation functions* such as SwiGLU, used in virtually all recent open-weights LMs. This introduces a new challenge: understanding positive activations is not enough. Instead, both the *gate* and the *in* activation of a neuron can be positive or negative, leading to four different possible sign combinations (*activation quadrants*) that in some cases have quite different functionalities (e.g. promoting vs. suppressing a specific set of tokens). translated_title: GLUScope：一个用于分析Transformer语言模型中GLU神经元的工具
translated_abstract: 我们提出了GLUScope，这是一个面向可解释性研究人员的开源资源，用于分析基于Transformer的语言模型（LM）中的神经元。我们聚焦于现已标准化、基于GLU的激活函数（如SwiGLU），这类激活函数几乎被所有近期开源权重的语言模型所采用。这带来了一个新的挑战：仅理解正激活是不够的。相反，神经元的门控激活和输入激活都可能为正或为负，从而产生四种不同的符号组合（激活象限），这些组合在某些情况下具有截然不同的功能（例如，促进还是抑制特定的一组token）。因此，对于任意神经元，我们的工具会展示四种符号组合各自的文本示例，并指出每种组合出现的频率。我们的资源能够带来新颖的洞见：特别是，得益于对所有四个激活象限的分析，它能够揭示原本可能被忽视的可解释行为。
tldr: GLUScope是一个开源工具，通过分析基于GLU激活函数的语言模型中神经元门控与输入激活的四种正负符号组合（激活象限），帮助可解释性研究者揭示神经元促进或抑制特定token等截然不同的功能行为。
en_tdlr: GLUScope is an open-source tool that helps interpretability researchers analyze GLU neurons in Transformer language models by examining all four activation quadrants (sign combinations of gate and in activations), revealing distinct functional behaviors such as promoting or suppressing specific tokens.
